+## Discuss first
+This card is a Multitool change for the hook system that was designed in a FoundationModelsACPAgent session (2026-10-19). Discuss it with the user before implementation starts. Precondition: `swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsHooks` is on GitHub with `SnapshotStore` (FoundationModelsHooks card "SnapshotStore").
+
+## What
+Add a `snapshots` capability that lets the model list and act on the workspace snapshots of its session. It uses a `SnapshotStore` that the host gives to it. The same store also goes to `SnapshotHook`, which takes the snapshots automatically on the tool events. The capability does not know about hooks.
+
+- `Package.swift`: add `FoundationModelsHooks` with `swissArmyHammerPackage(name:)`, and link its product to the library target. It already uses the same `swift-libgit2` version (1.9.7), so SwiftPM resolves one copy.

+- One file for each op, with `@Generable` arguments and results, as `Capabilities/Git/Status.swift` does:
+  - `list snapshots`: each checkpoint: index, trigger (tool name and tool call ID, or the label), changed files, date. Also say if a redo is available.
+  - `take snapshot`: optional `label`. Gives the new checkpoint, or "no change".
+  - `undo snapshot`: undoes the last checkpoint, and gives the restored files.
+  - `redo snapshot`: redoes the last undo, and gives the files.
+- A `SnapshotError` (`unavailable`, `nothingToUndo`, `nothingToRedo`) gives a corrective result that says why, in the style of the other capabilities. It does not throw out of the tool.
+- An undo inside a `runCode` snippet sets the store's `last` to the restored tree, so the `PostToolUse` snapshot of that `runCode` call finds no change and makes no checkpoint. Write this in the doc comment.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `list snapshots` over a store with two checkpoints gives both, oldest first.
+- [ ] `take snapshot` with a label after a file write gives a checkpoint with that label.
+- [ ] `undo snapshot` then `redo snapshot` gives the work tree before the undo.
+- [ ] `redo snapshot` with nothing to redo gives the corrective result, not an error.
+- [ ] A store whose session is not in a git work tree gives the corrective result for each op.
+- [ ] The capability is in the discovery surface (`searchTools`) with its four ops.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/SnapshotsCapabilityTests.swift` (Swift Testing): each criterion above, with `TemporaryGitRepository` from the test support target.
+- [ ] Run `swift test` in `/Users/wballard/github/swissarmyhammer/FoundationModelsMultitool`. All tests pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`. Write the failing tests first, then implement. #hooks #discuss
